note: fact_capable is set ONLY when a runner-owned oracle re-drive exists AND the ToolSpec passes the conformance battery (live.conformance). Everything else is LEAD-only or excluded. The count that matters is fact_capable, not the upstream tool count. Two FACT families are VIGIL-DIRECT (no tool is the authority): VERSION_RANGE via live.sbom (SBOM/dependency-CVE) and ACHIEVED_STATE via live.web_redrive (open_redirect / cors / host_header_injection over VIGIL's own gated capture, predicates scoped to the exploitable co-located condition; no-channel is INCONCLUSIVE not CLEAN). Their proposer tools (trivy/grype, httpx) keep fact_capable=false by design.

tools.name: sslscan

tools.name: httpx
tools.notes: HTTP exposure is re-derived by VIGIL's live.web_redrive ACHIEVED_STATE path (SHIPPED, no install): VIGIL issues its OWN gated, no-redirect HTTP capture and the deterministic predicate_oracle mints open_redirect / cors / host_header_injection FACTs — the tool is only a URL proposer, never the fact authority (fact_capable stays false). A no-channel probe is INCONCLUSIVE, never CLEAN. Other web classes stay LEAD-only pending their re-drive.
